Title

Hello, world! This is the first text written in Orische. Orische is a lightweight markup language for writing structured documents with simple and consistent syntax.

Inline Elements

Text can contain emphasised content to highlight an important phrase.

Inline code can be written with a code span, such as orische input.ori.

Links can include readable text: Visit the Orische repository

Inline elements can also be nested: Orische can contain inline code inside emphasised text.

Lists

Orische supports unordered lists.

  • Simple syntax
  • Clear document structure
  • Extensible block and inline elements
    • Block directives
    • Inline directives
      • Emphasis
      • Code spans
      • Links
  • HTML rendering

Ordered lists are also supported.

  1. Write an Orische document
  2. Parse the document into an AST
  3. Render the AST as HTML
    1. Render headings
    2. Render paragraphs
    3. Render lists
    4. Render code blocks

Code Block

A code block can specify a language. 


package main

import (
"fmt"
"os"
)

func main() {
fmt.Println("Hello from Orische")
os.Exit(0)
}

A code block can also omit the language. 


orische -o output.html input.ori
